messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 2155561234 — Notice: spike in 5xx responses for hosted-inference-us-west. Auto-created PagerDuty incident PD-8503 and paged current on-call.

pagerduty: Incident PD-8503 triggered. Notifying @oncall-lina.

oncall-lina: here. Acknowledged. Opening a war room and linking here. Need owners and quick impact estimate.

support-nina: war room up: https://warroom.redwood/INC-2155561234 (ops zoom + incident slack thread). Triage channel is #incidents.

ops-tera: assigning roles: infra owner: @sre-kim, runtime owner: @eng-ivan, PM/status: @pm-oliver, support lead: @support-nina. Please confirm.

sre-kim: confirmed. Quick check: node exporter shows elevated OOM kills on model-worker-2 around 10:12 UTC and restart loops on replica set.

eng-ivan: pulling runtime logs now. Seeing repeated errors: "failed to allocate kv-cache" and GC pauses. This started shortly after the config change to cache.shard_count=128 rolled out yesterday.

oncall-lina: initial impact: intermittent 5xx for some API keys, error rate ~6% for text-generation endpoint in us-west. Not global. Marking SEV2 for now.

pm-oliver: drafting status page text: 'Incident: increased error responses for hosted inference in us-west. Some requests may fail intermittently. Teams are actively investigating.' Suggest adding ETA for next update. Thoughts?

support-nina: add a line for customers: 'If you are experiencing errors please reply to your ticket with request ids and we'll prioritize.' Also enable auto-hold template on incoming tickets.

ops-tera: publish initial status, set updates every 10 minutes until mitigated. Avoid mentioning internal rollback plans on public page.

incident-bot: Status update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2155561234

sre-kim: commands run: ```kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep model-worker
kubectl logs -n inference rs/model-worker -c runtime --since=20m | tail -n 200``` seeing repeated "OOMKilled" on model-worker-2 and "kvcache: allocation failed" messages.

eng-ivan: reproduced issue on staging by applying the shard_count=128 change. Reverting to shard_count=64 on staging restored stability. Preparing rollback plan for prod with ops.

oncall-lina: timeline: incident detected 10:12 UTC, debugging in progress, rollback candidate tested staging at 10:20 UTC. If rollback approved will execute at 10:25 UTC with a quick canary and monitor 5m.

pm-oliver: preparing customer notification template in case we escalate to broader impact. Draft: 'We are currently mitigating an issue causing intermittent failures for the hosted inference API in us-west. Engineers are performing a targeted rollback to restore stability. We will update when service is restored or if the impact changes.' Approve to send once rollback begins?

support-nina: approve that text. Add a note to include customer-specific request-ids if they contact support.

ops-tera: please coordinate the rollback window. Eng-runbook: prefer staged rollout across nodes with health checks. Who will run the rollback?

eng-ivan: I will run the rollback image/config: revert configmap inference-cache to shard_count=64 and restart pods incrementally. I'll post start/complete times in this thread.

sre-kim: I'll monitor infra and node metrics, watch GPU mem and host OOM events. Alert me if restarts spike.

oncall-lina: paging confirmation: I've also notified central oncall and will escalate to #eng-oncall if we need extra hands. Handoff plan: if I'm offline, handoff to @sre-kim.

eng-ivan: rollback start 10:25 UTC — applying config revert and restarting model-worker replicas one at a time.

incident-bot: Note: automated heartbeat monitor will post if error rate does not drop within 10 minutes.

eng-ivan: rollback complete at 10:30 UTC for first 3 replicas; canary traffic now healthy, 5xx rate near baseline for canary. Continuing rolling restart of remaining replicas.

sre-kim: infra check: host memory stabilized; no new OOM events after canary.

pm-oliver: publishing status page update: 'Mitigation in progress: a targeted rollback is underway and initial canary shows improvement. We'll follow up with final resolution.'

support-nina: sending proactive customer notes to affected accounts with the template and linking to status page.

oncall-lina: plan: monitor for 30 minutes post-rollback. If stable, close PD incident and publish resolution. Please record actions and timestamps for postmortem.

ops-tera: reminder: capture exact git hash for rollback, config diff, and any operator commands in the incident doc store at /docs/incidents/2155561234. Blameless postmortem scheduled tomorrow.

eng-ivan: final update 10:44 UTC: rollout finished, global error rate back to normal for region, will continue monitoring.

incident-bot: PD-8503 auto-comment: incident status changed to under observation.

oncall-lina: resolving on-call for now. Handoff reachable to @sre-kim for monitoring. If anything changes ping me directly or escalate PD.

[end of thread 10:44 UTC7 — further notes will be added to the incident doc after resolution]
